youtube.description: 第32天早上八點，老宅大門口。建邦走到門口低聲說：安養院昨晚來電，玉琴這幾天都不肯吃飯，一直哼一首歌，要人唱給她聽才肯吃；就是那段影片裡，月棠在祠堂唱的那首，只有她會唱。月棠答應跟他去。林美鳳不服，建邦第一次頂回去：她回來照顧媽，住保母房，院方破例，中午他就帶她去。福伯接過她的藍布包。下午三點，兩人從安養院回來，玉琴聽著歌把一碗粥吃完了。江慕白在大廳等著：盛通把沈氏集團欠銀行的債整批買下了；周懷安的電話緊跟著打來，用印提前到這週日。建邦的手開始抖。林美鳳請江慕白去飯廳喝茶，江慕白把皮夾留在長桌上，先到院子回電話；林美鳳叫月棠「收拾」。月棠的手停在皮夾上，打開：附件三就在裡面，一行字被黑色麥克筆塗掉。院子裡的腳步聲回來了，她舉起手機拍，「咔」一聲快門響，江慕白在院子門口回頭。

data.prompt: Inside the main hall of the old Shen house on a winter afternoon, slanting sun from the front door laying a long rectangle of light on the floor, warm amber wood, the hanging lamp on: Shen Yuetang in her moon-white high-collared cotton shirt with frog buttons, the thick black braid over her right shoulder, stands before the open brown leather folio on the table below the frame; behind her only the wooden staircase on the east wall, out of focus. She is the only person in the frame, not smiling, very steady. Hearing footsteps returning from the courtyard, she raises her head, takes a plain black phone from the right pocket of her shirt with its back to the camera, holds it above the folio, and with her left hand presses the page flat. Mouth closed.
data.motion: She raises her head, takes out her phone with its back to the camera, holds it over the folio and presses the page flat.

data.prompt: Inside the main hall of the old Shen house on a winter afternoon, slanting sun from the front door laying a long rectangle of light on the floor, warm amber wood, the hanging lamp on, seen from the front door looking north, a black lacquer tea tray with three white lidded cups soft in the foreground. Two people: in the middle Shen Yuetang in her moon-white high-collared cotton shirt with frog buttons, the thick black braid over her right shoulder, stands at the east side of the long table, the brown leather folio lying flat before her, only its edge visible, and in her right hand a plain black phone held above it, its back to the camera; at the back right Jiang Mubai in his navy suit steps in through the small courtyard door, the phone in his right hand just lowered from his ear. The phone's shutter clicks; her hand freezes in mid-air; Jiang Mubai stops in the doorway and turns his head to look at her. Both mouths closed.
